facts.text: The resort is surrounded by white sand and the clear waters of the Caribbean.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by white sand and crystal-clear Caribbean waters, InterContinental Presidente Cancun Resort is a five-star luxury resort

facts.text: The resort is at Kilometer 7.5 of Boulevard Kukulkan in Cancun's Hotel Zone.
facts.excerpt: BLVD KUKULKAN KM 7.5 ZONA HOTELERA CANCUN

facts.text: Suites have private balconies with views of the Caribbean Sea.
facts.excerpt: Experience the charm and calm of the Caribbean Sea from luxury suites with private balconies and stunning ocean views.

facts.text: The outdoor pool has five jacuzzis and sits just steps from the Caribbean Sea, next to the Deck Bar.
facts.excerpt: Our 605 m2 pool has 5 jacuzzis and easy access to the Deck Bar and just 5 steps from the Caribbean Sea.

facts.text: The spa has a jacuzzi, sauna rooms and massage rooms.
facts.excerpt: Visit our premier spa, where you can relax in a jacuzzi, melt the stress away in sauna rooms, and indulge your senses in our massage rooms.

facts.text: The signature 80-minute IKAL massage combines four massage techniques from around the globe.
facts.excerpt: our special 80 minutes IKAL massage, a combination of four massage techniques from around the globe.

facts.text: El Caribeño, under a large palm-thatched roof, overlooks the beach.
facts.excerpt: It has a large palm thatched roof and overlooks Cancun's best beach to enjoy the sea breeze.

facts.text: Le Cap Beach Club serves Mediterranean cuisine on the beach, next to the adult pool.
facts.excerpt: Location: It is located on the beach and next to the adult pool

facts.text: The Deck Bar on the beach serves cocktails with sunset views.
facts.excerpt: Sample exclusive cocktails and enjoy breathtaking sunsets from our unique Deck Bar.

facts.text: Cancun Golf Club at Pok ta Pok is a 12-minute walk away, and Golf Puerto Cancun a 15-minute drive.
facts.excerpt: Golf Puerto Cancun is just a 15-minute drive away, while Cancun Golf Club at Pok ta Pok is just a 12-minute walk away.

facts.text: The resort is near the Convention Center, Party Center, Puerto Cancun and La Isla shopping centers.
facts.excerpt: We're near the Convention Center, Party Center, Puerto Cancun, and La Isla shopping centers.

facts.text: The resort is 25 minutes from Cancun International Airport.
facts.excerpt: 25 minutes from Cancun International Airport (CUN)

facts.text: Children are welcome at no extra charge when sharing their parents' room.
facts.excerpt: Little ones are welcome at no extra charge when sharing their parents’ room.

facts.text: The resort has a kids' club.
facts.excerpt: a kid’s club for children

facts.text: The hotel holds EarthCheck third-party sustainability certification.
facts.excerpt: Certifications: EarthCheck

facts.text: Dogs staying at the hotel get a bowl, bed, door sign and menu.
facts.excerpt: Dog: Bowl, bed, door sign and menu.

facts.text: Cabanas are available to rent.
facts.excerpt: Cabanas (for rent)

facts.text: The hotel is close to Cancun nightlife.
facts.excerpt: convenient location close to Cancun

facts.text: The hotel says its location gives it sargassum-free waters and a remarkably clean beach year-round.
facts.excerpt: Presidente InterContinental offers a remarkably clean beach year-round

facts.text: From the resort guests can easily transfer to Xcaret, Isla Mujeres, Tulum and Chichen Itza.

facts.text: Epicentro Mixology Bar is in the lobby.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in unique cocktails at Epicentro, the exclusive bar at Cancun Restaurant, Presidente InterContinental.
